description.narrative: Sida finansierar kapacitetsutveckling på Kambodjas statistikmyndighet genom Statistiska Centralbyrån i Sverige. Det övergripande målet är att bekämpa fattigdom och följa utvecklingen genom relevant och lättillgänglig statistik och analys, särskilt högkvalitativ statistik om utvecklingstrender.

Sida is financing capacity development at the National Institute of Statistics through Statistics Sweden. The overall objective is to combat poverty and monitor development by providing relevant and easily accessible data and analysis, in particular trend-data of good quality.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Intended outcome and the Intervention logic: The National Institute of Statistics, NIS, is part of the Ministry of Planning and is the official statistical institution of the Royal Government of Cambodia. NIS is responsible for the National Statistical System which is key to inform and improve public financial management, notably the budgeting process and monitoring and evaluation of public policies. National Accounts are of particular importance. They are based primarily on socio-economic surveys and price indexes. The cooperation between NIS and Sweden/Sida through Statistics Sweden (SCB) started in 2006, and has been implemented in three phases. The third phase came to and end on 30 June 2016 and focused on increasing NIS' capacity to generate and undertake basic national account statistics and, in particular, Cambodia Socio Economic Surveys (CSES).
During the project NIS has made substantial improvements in its ability to produce reliable statistics. The statistics that NIS produces are used to a greater extent than they used to be, especially by the Royal Government of Cambodia (RGC). Knowledge of statistics and their value have improved in the country, and financial support for NIS from the RGC has become more stable.
Results Summary of the whole contribution period
During the period 2012-2016 progress has been made in all three project components. Advances within the component Statistical Production have been most notable, including • NIS is able to carry out the planning and data collection phases of the Cambodia Socio- Economic Survey without technical assistance, • The data processing phase is carried out with only minimal technical assistance, and • Knowledge of surveys and the survey process has spread among NIS personnel; the large number of persons with experience and knowledge of surveys ensures that the institutional knowledge is sustainable; and, • The CSES is widely used by the RGC, international organizations and research institutions. • Financial support from the RGC for the CSES has increased. • Within the component National Accounts, methods used at NIS have improved and the NA statistics now make better use of the CSES data, however, significant improvements in NA statistics are still needed. • Within the Management/Infrastructure component, main accomplishments include a new Statistical Master Plan (2016), NIS annual reports for 2012-2015, a management manual including material for recruitment, job descriptions, and performance reviews; an active Women’s Network, and improved competency in statistics and English.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
